verdict.rationale: Bento documents transactional email for receipts, password resets, and login codes as one of three email types alongside broadcasts and sequences. It markets campaigns, automations, and transactional email 'in one place', and its CLI explicitly supports sending transactional emails next to broadcast creation via the API. Missing for 10: an explicit transactional-send API endpoint and payload in the evidence, details on per-message personalization and templates for transactional sends, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
